findings.summary: With sync on, the applied 'prefix/slug' also becomes the context name, creating a nested .worktrees/<prefix>/<slug> folder. Pre-existing behavior for hand-typed names; scoped out by the plan.
findings.action: Optional follow-up: set the context name to the slug only and keep prefix/slug for branch fields.

findings.summary: Popover/modal interaction (apply with sync on/off, hidden no-prefix option, Escape scoping) has no automated coverage; only domain logic is unit-tested.
findings.action: Add a component test if the project adopts React Testing Library.
